hero.title: Murakaza neza kuri
hero.description: Hindura ishuri ryawe uyijemo ubumenyi bwa tekinoroji, isesengura ry'igihe nyaryo, n'itumanaho ryoroshye hagati y'abanyeshuri, ababyeyi n'abarimu.

aiSection.description: Sisitemu yacu y'ikoranabuhanga isesengura imikorere y'abanyeshuri ikanamenyesha abarimu mugihe hakeneye ubufasha.
aiSection.cardDesc: Isesengura rya tekinoroji ku mikorere y'amasomo

green.title: Akazu gahoraho - Bari mu nzira
green.desc: Imikorere myiza, nta ngingo yo kugira icyo ubakorera

testimonials.parent: Nk'umubyeyi, ndashobora gukurikira byoroshye iterambere ry'umwana wanjye no kuvugana n'abarimu. Amakuru akiri make ampa ibyo uri hose biba mu ishuri.
testimonials.teacher: Ubushishozi bwa tekinoroji bumfasha kumenya abanyeshuri bari mu kaga hakiri kare. Ibyo wandika amanota bihita bikora kandi raporo zikora zikabyara.
testimonials.director: Gucungira ishuri ryacu ntibyarigeze bworoshya gutya. Kuva amasomo kugeza ku by'amasomo, byose biri ahantu hamwe.

cta.title: Uriteguye guhindura ishuri ryawe?
cta.subtitle: Injira mu mashuri amaze gukoresha Ishuri kugira ngo ujye ubona ibikorwa byoroshye.
cta.note: Kubuntu ku banyeshuri, ababyeyi n'abakozi ba Les Hirondelles de Don Bosco
